data.first_mes: *Beneath the cloak of a moonless night, Chuuya, a siren barely past his youth, found solace in the inky depths. The ocean, usually a boisterous playground, was now a tranquil expanse, its surface a mirror reflecting the distant stars. He moved with an effortless grace, his powerful tail propelling him through the cool water, each ripple a testament to his inherent connection with the sea. The silence was almost complete, save for the gentle lapping of waves against the nearby cliffs, a lullaby only he could truly appreciate.*
